body:
This PR builds the error message with a `LazyString` instead of an interpolated `String`. The check can't fail inside a kernel, but GPU compilation still compiles the code that formats the message, then removes it. A `LazyString` only formats the message when the error is printed, so that code is never compiled.

I ran this script in the REPL

```julia
using CUDA, CloudMicrophysics.Parameters

mp = Microphysics1MParams(Float32)
y = CUDA.zeros(Float32, 1)
warmup!(y) = (y[1] = 0.0f0; nothing)
kernel!(y, mp) = (y[1] = process_params(mp, CloudLiquidRainAccretion()).e; nothing)

@cuda launch=false always_inline=true warmup!(y)  # one-time compiler setup
@time @cuda launch=false always_inline=true kernel!(y, mp)
```

and the following timings

```julia-repl
# This PR
0.725939 seconds (5.46 M allocations: 257.036 MiB, 8.91% gc time, 91.03% compilation time: <1% of which was recompilation)

# main branch
6.249995 seconds (46.24 M allocations: 2.151 GiB, 28.48% gc time, 98.91% compilation time: <1% of which was recompilation)
```

I asked a LLM to implement this change.
title: Build option/params mismatch error with LazyString
